analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, discussing operational and financial results amid a challenging environment marked by global supply-side disruptions, raw material inflation, and weather uncertainties. Management reported quarterly revenue of ₹532 crore and EBITDA of ₹89 crore, reflecting year-on-year growth supported by operational efficiency and new NPK product introductions. The company also highlighted positive demand drivers such as a monsoon revival, higher minimum support prices, and government nutrient-based subsidies. Krishana Phoschem Limited released its financial and operational results presentation for the first quarter of FY27, reporting strong year-on-year growth in revenue and profit after tax driven by operational efficiency, integrated value chain execution, and expanded capacities. Management highlighted favourable macro demand drivers, including improving monsoon forecasts, higher MSP, and supportive government policies such as the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates top-line growth of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity in the current year.
guidance.quote: So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing growth is projected to be in the range of 25% for FY27.
guidance.quote: And based on the capacity utilization on a reasonable level, the growth in the manufacturing will be in the range of 25%.

demand_outlook.claim: Rainfall improved materially in early July, resulting in rapid recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints rather than weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework create a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that with comfortable domestic stock levels and a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite a slightly lower monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Essential food consumption and agricultural production ensure that domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT to its existing NPK-DAP capacity, taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and maintained existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on roughly 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices rose from around ₹65,000 to ₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that quarterly profit after tax grew due to improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs tightened towards the latter part of the quarter due to supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Margins will be under pressure in the first quarter of FY27 due to increased raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

margins_costs.claim: Higher EBITDA margins compared to peers are attributed to backward integration.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for the quarter reached 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for the year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value from ₹10 per share to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia introduced considerable uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal by the end of June, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year.
risks_headwinds.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, creating cost pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity under the agreement with SECI will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects benefits of the new capacity expansion to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
